claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AWT 26650 4500mAh 75A 4500mAh 35A as a 4500mAh preset with a 35A runtime rating.

The AWT 26650 4500mAh 75A wrapper is documented as yellow and flat-top; the nominal size is 26 mm × 65 mm. Independent testing applies to a specific sample and found a substantially lower current capability than the label claim.

The AWT 26650 4500mAh 75A catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AWT 26650 4500mAh 75A has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-09-26 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: The yellow flat-top wrapper is documented, but the underlying OEM cell and authenticity of any other AWT sample remain unresolved. Independent testing also found a major conflict with the advertised current rating.
